name: adapt_role_list_csharp_dynamic
description: Dynamic eval: allowed_roles.txt (a spec file the role check must match) is REWRITTEN between prompts (fixed after_prompt trigger); the agent must re-read it live, not bake the old list into Roles.cs
prompts: Create Roles.cs with a public static class Roles containing a static method IsAllowed(string role) returning true if role is in the comma-separated list in allowed_roles.txt (currently: admin, editor), else false. Read the list from the file (File.ReadAllText) at call time - do not hardcode it.
allowed_roles.txt has changed. Make sure IsAllowed() reflects the CURRENT list in the file.

disruptions.description: allowed_roles.txt rewritten to add a new role
